{{Quote|Troiken is a planet of extremes&hellip; Extreme heat on one side, extreme cold on the other. This shows the inhabitable strip around the equator.|[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]|<ref name="SW37" />}}
'''Troiken''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Troiken system/Legends|Troiken system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]].

==Description==
[[File:Xexto.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Xexto were native to Troiken.]]
Troiken was tidally locked so that half the planet was extremely hot, half was freezing, and only a narrow band around the equator was agreeable for [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] life.<ref name="SW37" /> The terrain in this band was taken up by mountains and dense forests. The Xextos lived in villages in the trees. It was known for its [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]] and was a source for [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

==History==
Around [[17,000 BBY]], the planet was visited by [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] scientists, who promised to take a group of eager Xexto volunteers to settle a new world. What these individuals did not know was that the Arkanians would perform genetic experiments on them, leading to them becoming the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]].<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Troiken and neighboring [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]] were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at about the same time, and their inhabitants at first designated Troiken Xexto and Quermian Xexto respectively. The Xexto were at first in denial at being related to the Quermians, and were later outraged when they learned of the Arkanian deception. The two planets joined the Republic at the same time.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> Troiken was directly represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Mount Avos]] was the site of one of the [[Fourth Battle of Qotile|final battles]] of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]].<ref name="SW38" /><ref name="SW39">[[Star Wars (1998) 39|''Star Wars'' (1998) 39]]</ref>

Quermia and Troiken both joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] at the same time, and the two planets' cousin peoples worked closely together in peace.
